Use case: stylized-concept. Create a character identity contact sheet for An Thanh pixel 2.5D MMORPG. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not its obsolete three classes. Crisp square pixel clusters, medium detail, roughly three-head-tall figures, restrained four shades per material, dark evergreen plain background. No smooth painting, no 3D models, no ornate overdesign. EXACTLY 19 separate full-body designs, each in its own generous cell, ordered left to right in FOUR ROWS of FIVE columns, last cell blank. All same 3/4 game camera, feet visible, no overlap or cropped weapons. Put ONLY the short Latin ID above each design, no other text.
Row1 PAL: living HUMAN holy knight white gold heavy plate ON armored horse holding broad TWO-HANDED greatsword; DKN: living HUMAN dark knight charcoal violet heavy plate ON dark armored horse, TWO-HANDED greatsword, not skeleton; HGD: HUMAN holy guardian ON horse silver blue plate ONE-HANDED mace AND clearly separate shield, NO wings; VAN: HUMAN vanguard steel rust armor TWO-HANDED long spear; BER: DWARF berserker short broad body TWO-HANDED axe.
Row2 WND: HUMAN wind swordsman light jade gray short asymmetric coat ONE sword and sheathed scabbard; ASN: ELF assassin slim pointed ears purple gray light armor TWO daggers; HSW: DWARF heavy swordsman sturdy short proportions TWO-HANDED straight greatsword; THU: HUMAN lightning mage angular violet gold robes TWO-HANDED forked staff; FIR: ELF fire mage pointed ears brick orange robes TWO-HANDED ember-headed staff.
Row3 WAT: HUMAN water mage curved blue silver robes TWO-HANDED drop-headed staff; NEC: HUMAN necromancer narrow ivory gray violet robe holding floating OPEN GRIMOIRE, NO staff; LGT: ELF light mage ivory pale gold robe prism-headed TWO-HANDED staff, offensive magical identity NOT priest; DRK: ELF dark mage indigo asymmetric robe crescent-headed TWO-HANDED staff NO book NO skeletons; EAR: DWARF earth mage broad short body ochre rock-layer short robe stone-headed TWO-HANDED staff.
Row4 ARC: DWARF archer short broad body light moss leather, bow and visible quiver; SPI: ELF spirit covenant caster split cream teal ritual robe OPEN-RING-headed TWO-HANDED pactstaff, NOT leafy healer; PRI: HUMAN priest ivory warm gold ceremonial vertical robes HOLY STAFF no armor; WOD: ELF wood healer leaf-panel cream green robe budding WOOD STAFF NOT spirit caster; finalcell blank.
Three mounted knights fully visible including horses; scale mounted figures to fit cells while riders keep same body proportions. NO permanent wings or huge glowing auras: wing progression is separate. Small restrained weapon motifs only. This is a CONCEPT BOARD, not animation/spritesheet. Each weapon must clearly distinguish classes.
foundation:
Use case stylized-concept. Pixel fantasy character concept board for An Thanh MMORPG. Match reference pixel cluster medium detail, three-head proportions, deep evergreen background, sharp square edges, no painted smoothness. EXACTLY TEN separate full-body cells in TWO ROWS FIVE columns, ample margins weapons never overlap. Each cell ONLY its short uppercase label, no explanatory text. This is a progression reference, NOT ten classes.
Row1 left to right:
HUM: human NOVICE, plain tan short cloth shirt belt trousers boots, neutral proportions, no armor no magic no weapon.
ELF: elf NOVICE slender slightly taller visibly pointed ears, plain tan short cloth shirt belt trousers boots, no leaves no robe no weapon.
DWF: dwarf NOVICE distinctly short broad shoulders short limbs, plain tan short cloth shirt broad belt trousers sturdy boots, optional short beard, NO heavy armor, not scaled-down human, no weapon.
KNI: human level15 KNIGHT on fully visible brown horse, practical steel blue plate, one-handed sword AND shield, no wings no holy/dark symbols.
WAR: dwarf level15 WARRIOR, practical steel leather open shoulder movement, TWO-HANDED axe.
Row2:
SWD: elf level15 SWORD ADEPT, light gray short asymmetric coat, single one-handed sword and empty offhand, no daggers.
MAG: human level15 MAGE plain blue modest robe, neutral crystal two-handed staff, no specific fire/lightning element.
ARC: dwarf level15 ARCHER moss leather short coat, bow and quiver, NOT gun.
SPI: elf level15 SPIRIT profession caster cream teal split ritual robe, OPEN-RING pactstaff, NO leaves, not wood healer.
PRI: human level15 PRIEST ivory warm-gold simple long robe holy staff, no heavy armor.
All figures same game 3/4 direction fullbody, ground shadow only. One example race per profession is illustrative, not race permission chart. Horse comfortably fits cell. Balanced readable silhouette more important than ornament, four shades per material, no large magic effects. Keep native-sprite-like blocky rendering though image is conceptual.
